name: dsh-session-bridge
description: Read and message every DeepSeek Harness (DSH) session from one CLI or from a DSH plugin — list sessions, read transcripts, send messages, and chat across sessions with a one-line per-turn menu.

scripts.check: python3 -m py_compile tools/dshctl.py tools/dshtool.py && node --check lib/index.mjs && node --check bin/dshctl.mjs
